#!/bin/bash
set -u
mkdir -p /tmp/_xm_front_sync
echo '=== 同步 memory.html ==='
rm -f /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0
curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/0948f2a28c41e6a20d4ca666093ab4981409d0e1/memory.html' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 || curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/memory.html?ref=0948f2a28c41e6a20d4ca666093ab4981409d0e1' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 || { echo '下载失败: memory.html'; exit 11; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != '89f034a1a8df621ffd2d2f41e23a6a80b00f445e90f26f59a5bd7246ef4ffcd3' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=89f034a1a8df621ffd2d2f41e23a6a80b00f445e90f26f59a5bd7246ef4ffcd3"; exit 12; fi
sudo install -D -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 '/var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html'
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S '/var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html'
sha256sum '/var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html'
echo '=== 同步 assets/js/memory-graph.js ==='
rm -f /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1
curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/c2da86c3404c9dbc2859524fbdc192f2ba205c43/assets/js/memory-graph.js' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 || curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/assets/js/memory-graph.js?ref=c2da86c3404c9dbc2859524fbdc192f2ba205c43' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 || { echo '下载失败: assets/js/memory-graph.js'; exit 11; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != 'd88bb4d3447e9fbbdc93e45f9af2ed48aa3ce31213d1c161ce084de5a07cd189' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=d88bb4d3447e9fbbdc93e45f9af2ed48aa3ce31213d1c161ce084de5a07cd189"; exit 12; fi
sudo install -D -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph.js'
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph.js'
sha256sum '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph.js'
echo '=== 同步 assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js ==='
rm -f /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_2
curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/d2f9a34e9156cca29fead2ed5b4665ccf3647cd4/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_2 || curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js?ref=d2f9a34e9156cca29fead2ed5b4665ccf3647cd4' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_2 || { echo '下载失败: assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js'; exit 11; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_2 | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != '96d9c391a05986f8dadc924a0fd3fe39dadc7cce05bd67d6b75e90a738289df9' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=96d9c391a05986f8dadc924a0fd3fe39dadc7cce05bd67d6b75e90a738289df9"; exit 12; fi
sudo install -D -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_2 '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js'
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js'

echo '=== 同步 assets/js/memory-graph-view.js ==='
rm -f /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_3
curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/0ee2835fc9e9e8d02e741cd0520fa4ccb51af541/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_3 || curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js?ref=0ee2835fc9e9e8d02e741cd0520fa4ccb51af541' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_3 || { echo '下载失败: assets/js/memory-graph-view.js'; exit 11; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_3 | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != '8beed008d6d66015509943622f9d6d2146bcb077bd161abf7622998867c3f548' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=8beed008d6d66015509943622f9d6d2146bcb077bd161abf7622998867c3f548"; exit 12; fi
sudo install -D -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_3 '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js'
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js'
